project_type: Go daemon for Android Magisk module (SSHCustom-VPNChain) - SSH tunnel with WebUI
build_system: Go cross-compilation (GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64/arm CGO_ENABLED=0), shell build script (build.sh)
test_framework: Go testing (go test ./...) with tests in cmd/sshcustomd/main_test.go and internal/dnsx/dnsx_test.go
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'go test ./...' to confirm all tests pass. 2. Run 'GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build ./cmd/sshcustomd/' to confirm cross-compilation works. 3. Run 'GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm CGO_ENABLED=0 go build ./cmd/sshcustomd/' to confirm arm32 build.
snapshot_or_generated_files: internal/webui/index.html and internal/webui/favicon.svg are copied from src/module/webroot/ before build (embed files)
setup_instructions: Go 1.23+ is pre-installed. No external dependencies needed (golang.org/x/crypto is vendored in third_party/). Run: export GOFLAGS=-mod=mod
environment_constraints: No Docker daemon available. No Android device for runtime testing. Validate via go build and go test only. The project vendors its only dependency (golang.org/x/crypto) via a replace directive pointing to third_party/.
contribution_requirements: Module path is github.com/GoodyOG/SSHCustom_Magisk. Version stamped via ldflags. Build produces static binaries for arm64 and arm.
key_patterns: Single-file daemon (cmd/sshcustomd/main.go ~4015 lines). Uses golang.org/x/crypto/ssh for SSH. Config is JSON at src/module/config/config.json. Profiles at src/module/config/profiles.json. WebUI is embedded via go:embed in internal/webui/. API is HTTP on 127.0.0.1:9190 with /api/v1/* routes. State changes broadcast via SSE. SSHPool manages multiple SSH sessions with round-robin stream dispatch.
directory_structure: cmd/sshcustomd/ - daemon entry point and all main logic. internal/ - packages (apiv1, dnsx, iptables, metrics, version, webui). src/module/ - Magisk module files (scripts, config, webroot, bin/). third_party/ - vendored golang.org/x/crypto. dist/ - build output.
